name: habakuk007/evangtermine
description: Development tooling for the WordPress plugin Evangelische Termine. Not part of the release.

scripts-descriptions.lint:php: Full ruleset from phpcs.xml (WordPress Coding Standards + PHPCompatibilityWP).
scripts-descriptions.lint:compat: PHP compatibility sniffs only (PHP 7.4 and newer).
scripts-descriptions.make:pot: Extract the translatable strings into languages/evangtermine.pot (WP-CLI i18n from Composer, no global wp needed).
scripts-descriptions.make:mo: Compile all .po files in languages/ to .mo.
